title: power-up pickups half size
why: His order (2026-10-20): "powerups need to be like 50^ smaller". The floating pickups (bottomless clip, double damage, rapid fire, shield bubble, screen clear) draw at half size through one constant PWRK: medallion, glyph, rim, glow, hover height, bob, spawn flash and beam width. The reach ring keeps its size so picking one up plays the same, and the beam keeps its height so it still shows from far away.
now: Power-up pickups are half the size. Picking them up works the same.
